newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian budget funds must go through Treasury only.
newsitem.headline: Russian budget funds must go through Treasury only.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin said federal budget funds should be distributed only through the Treasury, the formation of which would be completed this year.
"As a result we will finish with the practice of profiteering from budget money which passes through commercial banks," Yeltsin said in his annual address to the Russian parliament.
Under the current system, budget funds are channelled to territories and regions though authorised banks.

Competition for the right to handle budget money is high and critics have said the system is poorly controlled and prone to corruption. Some banks delay transfer of the funds, investing them instead in the money or currency market.
Yeltsin also said a Budget Code must be adopted this year.
This would "ensure order in the handling of the budget and the expenditure of government means," he said.
